title: The Seal Shatters
next_chapter_hook: Just as everyone was still reeling from shock, the third page of the Tianji Record revealed itself on its own—depicting a vertical pupil exactly like the one from the depths of the seal, as if some resonance spanning ten thousand years.

text.content: The stabbing pain from his brow center felt like ten thousand needles piercing simultaneously. Chen Ji instinctively pressed his forehead, the skin beneath his fingertips burning as if seared by a branding iron. The Heavenly Fate Value drained away like a breached dam—fifty points, sixty, seventy—with each loss his complexion grew paler. The low hum from the seal's depths grew clearer, not a sound but a direct injection of will into his soul. 'It' was awakening. The surrounding spiritual energy of heaven and earth abruptly went into chaos, forming a massive vortex centered on the seal. Countless stone fragments peeled from the cliff walls, falling into the bottomless chasm.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! Why do you look so terrible?

text.content: Su Qingyao grabbed the staggering Chen Ji, her pupils narrowing when her fingertips touched his ice-cold skin—such extreme weakness was far from normal. Her gaze swept over Chen Ji's forehead that he was desperately pressing, and alarm bells rang in her heart. Thistrashdisciple, always showing exhaustion at critical moments—exactly what secret was he hiding? In the distance, screams of terror rose from disciples of other sects. Someone's flying sword lost control due to the spiritual energy disturbance and plummeted directly toward the crowd.

dialogue.content: This aura... something's wrong! This isn't an ordinary ancient existence!

text.content: Ye Qing's voice sharply pitched higher. The Demon Path Saintess, always composed, rarely showed a trace of fear. She could sense the power surging from the seal's depths—strangely resonating with the Demon Path techniques she cultivated, as if... as if they shared the same origin. The cracks in the seal were expanding visibly, a幽green light seeping through the gaps, illuminating half the horizon.

choice.prompt: The seal is about to shatter, the ancient existence is awakening—Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.description: Preserving strength is paramount. Since the seal cannot be stopped, the priority is to evacuate everyone from the danger zone. As long as we're alive, there will be another day.
choices.visible_cost: Abandon the chance to investigate the truth of the seal
choices.visible_reward: Protect the lives of all present disciples, establish leadership prestige
choices.risk_hint: The ancient existence's awakening may lead to greater catastrophe

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the intense pain from his brow center. He scanned his surroundings—chaotic crowds, crumbling rocks, increasingly dazzling green light—the situation was irreversible. 'Everyone, listen to my command!' His voice suddenly rang across the valley, robust and resolute, completely unlike his usualtrashimage. 'Evacuate immediately! Go east, don't look back!'

dialogue.content: (Heart shaken) This command... so decisive. Is this still that person who was bullied by everyone?

choices.description: While the seal hasn't completely shattered, use the incomplete Tianji Record to attempt suppression—even if it only delays things for a moment.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate Value, possible collapse on the spot
choices.visible_reward: If successful, thoroughly investigate the connection between the seal and Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Using the incomplete Tianji Record against an ancient existence carries extremely high risk

text.content: Chen Ji bit his tongue sharply, using blood as a catalyst to force the incomplete Tianji Record from his brow center. The yellowed pages slowly unfurled in the void, the ink upon them writhing like living creatures. He formed seals with both hands, low incantations spilling from his lips. The spreading green light from the seal actually paused for an instant—as if forcibly suppressed by some power.

dialogue.content: (Pupils violently dilating) This aura... Tianji Record? You actually possess such a divine object!

text.content: Before the words even finished, the seal's cracks suddenly expanded threefold. The幽green light surged forth like a tide—where it passed, rocks turned to powder, ancient trees withered to ash. A vast pressure like an abyss enveloped the entire area. Disciples with lower cultivation当场spit blood, their knees going soft. A blurry silhouette flickered in the green light—a vertical pupil, containing power sufficient to change heaven and earth.

dialogue.content: Everyone run! I'll hold the rear!

text.content: Su Qingyao drew her sword, the cold light blooming from the blade attempting to resist that overwhelming pressure. Her cultivation was already late Foundation Building stage, outstanding among her generation. Yet when that vertical pupil in the green light glanced at her, her sword intent nearly collapsed. Cold sweat dripped from her temples, an unprecedented sense of powerlessness surging in her heart—what level of existence was this?

In the chaos, disciples from various sects fled in all directions. Some tried to ride their swords upward but man and sword plummeted together due to spiritual energy disturbance; others attempted to form defensive formations only to be instantly dismantled by the green light. The exploration team that the three great sects had painstakingly organized became lambs waiting for slaughter at this moment. Xuanwu Sect disciples stared at that vertical pupil in horror, their sturdy physiques that they'd always taken pride in trembling uncontrollably.

choice.prompt: The situation took a sharp turn. Su Qingyao holding the rear alone is already showing signs of exhaustion—Chen Ji must choose again—

choices.description: A beautiful woman is in grave danger; cannot let her die alone. Even if it means exposing some of my strength, I must get her out safely.
choices.visible_cost: Completely expose the connection with Tianji Record to Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: Deepen the bond with Su Qingyao, gain her deeper trust
choices.risk_hint: She will become even more suspicious of your true identity

text.content: A cold glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. He could not watch Su Qingyao die here, even though she was his greatest threat. He activated the Tianji Record again, a gentle yet irresistible force lifting Su Qingyao and forcibly pushing her backward. 'Go!' His voice was ice-cold, devoid of any emotion.

choices.text: Join forces with Ye Qing to suppress
choices.description: Ye Qing's Demon Path mist can conceal the Tianji Record's aura. The two of us working together might buy more time to investigate the truth.
choices.visible_cost: Allying with the Demon Path Saintess will give people ammunition to criticize
choices.visible_reward: Deeply understand the connection between the seal and Tianji Record, possibly gain crucial clues
choices.risk_hint: What will orthodox disciples think of cooperating with the Demon Path?

text.content: Chen Ji and Ye Qing's gazes met in mid-air; without words they reached an understanding. The Demon Path Saintess' surroundings surged with thick black mist, intertwining with the Tianji Record's aura. Two forces that should never coexist merged strangely, forcibly tearing an opening in that green light.

Just then, the seal completely shattered. That vertical pupil slowly opened—within its depths lay a chaotic star sea, as if containing all the mysteries of the universe's birth. A soundless will swept across the entire area. Chen Ji felt his soul being gazed upon by some force, as if all his secrets were laid bare. The Tianji Record violently trembled against his chest, the sound of pages turning clearly audible.

Chen Ji forcefully endured the soul-probing pain, his mind racing. Why was this ancient existence's aura so similar to the Tianji Record? Friend or foe? The Heavenly Secrets Eye mentioned in Volume Eight that the Tianji Record was merely one of its pieces on the board in this world... So was the existence in this seal also a piece? Or was it a force beyond the chessboard?

dialogue.content: (Inner voice) Noted. Whoever you are, today's debt will be settled in the future.

text.content: The vertical pupil's gaze swept across the chaotic crowd, finally fixing on Chen Ji. There was no killing intent in that gaze—instead, a hint of... scrutiny, as if confirming something. Chen Ji's hairs stood on end, yet he forced himself to remain calm. He slowly lowered the Tianji Record in his hands, letting the pages float in the void. The green light from the seal and the Tianji Record reflected each other; everyone present witnessed this unbelievable scene.

The Tianji Record's pages abruptly flipped to the third page. On the yellowed paper, a vertical pupil exactly like the one in the seal was clearly depicted, and beneath the pupil was a line of ancient seal script that Chen Ji had never seen before—the characters seemed to breathe, seemed to speak of some secret spanning ten thousand years. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind: 'The third page... the unsealing condition has been met. It has found you, kid.'

The green light gradually收敛, the vertical pupil slowly closed. That ancient existence seemed only to be confirming something; upon confirmation, it sank back into the seal's depths—or rather, it wasn't truly awakening, merely 'opening its eyes to take a look.' But that brief moment was enough to terrify everyone present to their core. Chen Ji stared at the seal script on the third page, his heart surging with enormous waves. Why would the Tianji Record's third page depict the ancient existence's totem? Between these two, what unknown connection existed?

choice.prompt: The ancient existence returned to silence, the third page manifested—Chen Ji faces the final choice—

choices.description: Opportunity waits for no one; must take advantage of the ancient existence's slumber to clarify its connection with the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: Everyone present can see the third page's contents
choices.visible_reward: Gain key information about the relationship between the ancient existence and Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao will be even more certain that you possess the Tianji Record

text.content: Chen Ji unhesitatingly projected his spiritual sense into the third page. In an instant, countless images flashed through his mind like a carousel—ancient altars, bloody sacrifices, the birth of the Tianji Record... and a name deliberately erased. Who did that name belong to? Why was it erased? Before he could clearly see, the images suddenly vanished.

choices.description: More important than truth is sorting out the chaos and establishing his leadership position in this crisis.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the optimal timing to study the third page
choices.visible_reward: Everyone present will be deeply grateful, prestige will greatly increase
choices.risk_hint: The third page's information may vanish in an instant

text.content: Chen Ji put away the Tianji Record and turned to face the collapsed crowd. He didn't rush to examine the third page's contents; instead, he quickly moved toward the injured disciples, distributing elixirs and directing evacuation. Amid the ruins, his busy figure overlapped with the image of someone commanding an army moments ago.trash? At this moment, no one dared use that word to describe him.

Su Qingyao struggled to stand, her gaze firmly locked on Chen Ji. The scene just now was too shocking—Tianji Record, the ancient existence, and Chen Ji's composure and decisiveness completely at odds with histrashimage. She wanted to question, but seeing Chen Ji's calm, still-water-like eyes, she swallowed all her doubts. This man... just how many secrets was he still hiding? Ye Qing watched the subtle atmosphere between Chen Ji and Su Qingyao with a thoughtful expression, a playful arc curving at the corner of his lips.

Just as everyone was still reeling from shock, the third page of the Tianji Record revealed itself on its own—depicting a vertical pupil exactly like the one from the seal's depths, as if some resonance spanning ten thousand years. The ancient seal script slowly appeared beneath the vertical pupil: 'The Heavenly Secrets were forged by the Eye of Heavenly Dao. However, the one who forged the Eye was not the Eye itself.' Chen Ji stared at this sentence, his heart suddenly racing. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed in his mind: 'It seems it's time to tell you some truths... about the Tianji Record's true origins.'
